name: DALI
summary: DALI combines a magnetized phased array and Fabry–Pérot tuners to retain a large conversion area at high frequencies; its prototype published its first axion limits in 2026.
detection_principle: Dielectric plates and an open resonator enhance axion-generated electromagnetic waves in a magnetic field; low-noise receivers analyze narrow frequency spectra.

results.summary: No significant axion signal; coupling sensitivity near 28.54 μeV reaches approximately 9.7×10⁻¹² GeV⁻¹.

science_scope: Directly searches for Galactic-halo axions, axionlike particles or other ultralight dark matter. Limits depend on assumed local density, velocity distribution and coupling models; separate scanned mass intervals do not amount to exclusion of the entire range.
